text:
alex: Heads up — I just spotted a weird new line on the April eu-west2 invoice: an \"accelerator-support\" charge that appears twice for the same project. Not present in March. Anyone seen this pattern?

mira: Which project/account? can you paste the line items?

alex: project-id: redwood-prod-eu

alex: ```
Invoice: 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-30
LineItem: accelerator-support | region=eu-west2 | qty=1 | amount=£2,400.00
LineItem: reserved-accelerator-credit-offset | region=eu-west2 | qty=-1 | amount=-£2,400.00
LineItem: accelerator-support | region=eu-west2 | qty=1 | amount=£2,400.00
```

sam-eng: whoa that looks duplicated. Could be a billing adapter double-writing marketplace addon + support SKU. tagging @mira for infra context. :eyes:

mira: on it. I will pull the billing export CSV and check the sku ids and usage_start_time.

finance-bot: Automated alert: daily-billing-scan found an outlier in project redwood-prod-eu (eu-west2) — duplicate support-like lines detected. Ticket created: #BILL-5631

natalie: I saw a similar one in a smaller account last quarter — turned out to be our reseller flag + direct SKU both applied. Did we recently enable any marketplace addons for that project?

mira: We did a node-pool managed-support enable for Dedicated EU pool on 2026-03-29 (capacity rollout). That added a Marketplace support sku in addition to the reserved support charge from the commitment. Could be a mapping collision.

sam-eng: Copying the billing export snippet from GCP API: ```
usage_start_time,sku_description,sku_id,project_id,cost
2026-04-01,Accelerator Support,SKU-ACC-SUPP-xyz,redwood-prod-eu,2400.00
2026-04-01,Reserved Accelerator Support Credit,SKU-ACC-RES-abc,redwood-prod-eu,-2400.00
2026-04-01,Accelerator Support,SKU-ACC-SUPP-xyz,redwood-prod-eu,2400.00
```

alex: so the credit exists but we still have two positive charges + one negative. net +2400. That's the anomaly (we expect net 0).

natalie: Filing to cloud support makes sense, but we should reconcile customer-side first: does our commitment system match the reservation id on the invoice?

mira: I looked up the reservation metadata — reservation_id=rsv-eu-dedicated-03. Only one reservation attached. The second positive charge has an extra label: marketplace_seller=thirdparty-support. That suggests the marketplace addon and our reservation both billed.

sam-eng: action items: 1) Confirm whether marketplace addon was intentionally enabled (mira) 2) Request GCP invoice reclassification / credit for duplicate marketplace support (finance) 3) Add rule in billing adapter to dedupe support SKUs when reservation credit exists (eng)

alex: assigning: @mira confirm addon; @natalie to open GCP support case referencing #BILL-5631; @sam-eng can you draft the billing-adapter PR?

mira: confirmed — addon was enabled as part of the Dedicated rollout, but the intention was to rely on the reserved support credit only. I will disable the marketplace addon for that pool and capture timeline. :white_check_mark:

natalie: Support case opened: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/987654321; subject: \"Duplicate accelerator-support charge in eu-west2 — possible marketplace + reservation overlap\". Asked for provisional credit and invoice patch.

sam-eng: I'll sketch a quick lambda to dedupe by sku_id + reservation_label and add a test. Will add it to the billing-adapter backlog and tag as P0 for this week.

ops-bot: Deploy bot: billing-adapter v1.14.2 rolled back earlier today (2026-04-02) — related change: marketplace sku mapping tweak. Might be linked.

alex: interesting — rollback could explain timing. we enabled addon 3/29, adapter tweak 4/02, invoice with dups for April. timeline lines up.

mira: For audit: I exported full invoice row ids and put them in the ticket. Also adding a note to the Dedicated rollout checklist to verify marketplace flags.

natalie: Finance will request a credit for the net £2,400 and hold payment until resolved. Marking this as billing-impacting.

sam-eng: once PR is up I'll include a one-off backfill that aggregates by (project,sku,start_date) and collapses duplicates into single net cost before export. That should prevent double-charges hitting downstream chargeback.

alex: thanks all. Please update #BILL-5631 when you have any reply from GCP support. If we get a credit, let's also run a retro on the adapter rollout process. :memo:

mira: update 2143659200 — marketplace addon disabled at 12:15 UTC, node-pool still healthy.

natalie: update 2143659765 — GCP responded, they provisionally issued a credit for the duplicate marketplace support line and requested our invoice rows for reconciliation. Closing loop once credit posts. :raised_hands:
